einzeiler: Julia Turner introduces her new podcast LA World with an excerpt on the delayed LAX train.
kurzfassung: Julia Turner presents an excerpt from her new weekly podcast, LA World, focusing on the severely delayed and over-budget LAX people mover project. The hosts discuss the tense legal battles between the city and the developers just weeks before a major financial deadline. They also examine a surprisingly dramatic civil grand jury report detailing the project's troubled history.
stichpunkte: Julia Turner launches her new weekly podcast LA World alongside co-hosts Antonia Serahito and Hayes Davenport.
The featured episode examines the LAX automated people mover, officially named SkyLink.
The transit project is currently three years late, nearly one billion dollars over budget, and facing an October 2026 financial deadline.
Construction consortium LYNX recently sued the city, escalating tensions between the developers and Los Angeles World Airports.
Despite being reported as 99.6 percent complete, the system remains closed to the public.
A civil grand jury report used unusual dramatic formatting to criticize the project's original dispute resolution mechanisms.
Reviewers and YouTubers analyzing the documents suggest the project neutral consistently favored the contractors.
The hosts compare the toxic relationship between the city and developers to a dysfunctional marriage needing serious mediation.

clips.hook: Three years late and nearly one billion over budget
clips.text: The airport train project was initially approved in 2018 with a scheduled completion date in 2023, but it has missed that target by years while accumulating massive financial overruns.

clips.hook: The train is nearly done, but still nobody can ride it
clips.text: Even though construction metrics officially place the transit system at almost complete, passengers still have no access to the actual service.

clips.hook: A massive settlement aimed to finish the project by the World Cup
clips.text: The city and developers previously agreed to a massive financial injection of over half a billion dollars to wipe the slate clean and finish the work in time for the global soccer tournament.

clips.hook: A civil grand jury report written like a dramatic screenplay
clips.text: Official investigators chose an extremely unorthodox stylistic approach for their report, incorporating theatrical dialogue and famous movie quotes instead of dry administrative language.

clips.hook: Why neither side can afford to walk away from the table
clips.text: The developers face total corporate collapse if lenders pull out, while the city would be forced to restart the entire process with very few qualified alternatives available worldwide.

beschreibung:
L.A. World is a new weekly podcast from L.A. Material, the local news outlet that Julia Turner helped launch earlier this year. The show helps you understand what's happening in Los Angeles. Every episode, Julia is joined by hosts Hayes Davenport and Antonia Cereijido to walk you through L.A.'s top stories, offering context and distinctive insight you can't get anywhere else. A great listen for Angelenos, and for curious people everywhere.
